### New in 1.7.3
- **Share books by QR code**:
  - On Home, press and hold a book and drop it on the new 🛍️ share bag. The book stays on your shelf; the bag just carries a copy. Add as many as you like.
  - The bag waits on the right side of Home and slides to the middle while you drag a book.
  - Tap the bag to see what's inside, take books out, or tap **Share as QR** to turn them all into one QR code. Share the code to any app, or save it to Photos.
- **Scan shared books**: the button at the top of Home now opens a QR scanner. Scan a friend's code with the camera, or pick a saved picture of one from your gallery. You'll see each book's details, then they go onto a new **Shared** shelf.
- **Sticky notes on the To-do page**:
  - A pinned note now stays inside its to-do, even when adding a to-do moves or resizes it.
  - The New and Edit note windows have a **Pin to a to-do** list, so you can pin a note to any to-do, move it to another one, or unpin it.
  - Deleting a to-do frees the notes pinned to it instead of hiding them.

The old Send / Receive sharing is replaced by the share bag.

### Install / update
Download `shelfwise.apk` below and open it. It installs over 1.7.2 and keeps all your data. Coming from 1.7.1 or older? See the one-time steps in the [1.7.2 notes](https://github.com/RajkumarPadmanabhan/update-shelf/releases/tag/v1.7.2).
